$comment: Dependency advisories this repository knowingly accepts, asserted by
`npm audit` has no inline exception mechanism, so acceptance is expressed here
and checked. The assertion is deliberately two-sided: no critical may exist at
all, and the high-severity set must equal the accepted set exactly. That way an
accepted advisory cannot quietly outlive its review, and a new one cannot hide
Every entry needs a reason and a `reviewed` date. Removing an entry fails the
build, which is intended: acceptance must be re-decided, not inherited.
The rationale for each accepted advisory is written out in

acceptedHigh.reason: Prisma CLI internals (config loading and RPC plumbing) used by generate, migrate, db:validate, db:drift and db:invariants. No patched stable release exists; npm's only suggestion is a downgrade to 6.12.0, which moves backwards. Not reachable from any request path, and @prisma/client itself carries no advisory.
